Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/4-010.htm.text: Winter Hunter Kadyth: If you want the forbidden power, you need the skills. This bow? It's not stolen. I keep it in the secret compartment under the Hunter Guild exhibit, right under the guild president's nose. Use this Stone of Commune with the tablet. I must go now. I look forward to a friendly c…

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/4-011.htm.text: Winter Hunter Kadyth: Here's the Stone of Commune. Maybe we'll meet again. I have to go help a newbie, my favorite thing.

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/4-09.htm.text: Winter Hunter Kadyth: Take the Stone of Commune to the Tablet of Vision over there. I must hunt for more game. See you later.
